description.value: Hemlock Hut is a 225 sq. ft. off-grid backcountry ski hut perched at 2,000 m in the Selkirk Mountains outside Revelstoke, operated by Revelstoke Backcountry Guides on a private tenure and reached exclusively by helicopter from Glacier Helicopters. The hut sleeps up to four guests on an exclusive buyout basis and features a wood stove, propane cookstove, solar power, and a custom wood-burning sauna used as a daily ritual after skiing. All trips are fully guided (ACMG) and catered, with guests and guide sharing custodial duties such as hauling water and stoking fires.

None of the website content references bicycles, bike storage, or any cycling-related amenities; the solar power system is the only amenity with bearing on the optional checklist ('solar power for lights and charging'). Contact details (phone +1 250-419-7656, address Revelstoke BC V0E 2S0) are confirmed in the website footer.

This is a helicopter-accessed, winter-only backcountry ski hut at 2,000 m elevation. There is no road, trail, or summer access mentioned anywhere on the site, making it effectively inaccessible to touring cyclists. Cycling-specific amenities are entirely absent.
The hut is only available as an exclusive 4-person guided buyout trip; it is not a walk-in or drop-in accommodation.
